system.description:
Deal [[/r 1d6 +@battle-status.power.magic.total ]]{[(SR)D + (Magic Power)]}  magical damage to the target, and the target takes [Decay: 5]. This [Decay] does not overwrite [Decay] effect the target is already affected by, and instead adds to its rating.

An attack magic that summons a raging spirit from a formation that imitates a magatama to attack the enemy. Magatama leads to evil spirits. The spirit's resentment torments the enemy's soul and continues to inflict terrible pain.
